thread:
nina: noticed p95 spike on /v1/embed in ap-south, p50/p99 look inconsistent across slices. anyone else?
sam: yep, saw it after the routing tweak last night. p95 up ~130ms, p99 unchanged.
lucas: could be sampling blending. do we drop client_transport during daily rollup? I think transport gets collapsed.
nina: query from metrics shows transport split: http p95 210ms (count 340), grpc p95 85ms (count 900)
sam: so combined p95 pulled up by small-but-slow http cohort. that explains p99 staying put if grpc has the heavy outliers.
lucas: options: keep transport label for routes where split changes quantiles by >X, or surface small-cohort badge in console.
ops-bot: ticket created METRICS-7433: add cohort-warning + quick-split action (assignee: sam)
nina: prefer badge + one-click split. don't want to increase rollup cardinality globally.
sam: I'll implement console badge + add quick filter that calls backend with groupby["transport"]
lucas: I'll add an optional rollup-annotation param annotations=["transport"] and min_cohort_size threshold to prevent storage blowup.
nina: thanks! also update the docs about label collapse effects on percentiles.
ops-bot: note: deploy scheduled for next sprint.
